# ImagineArt

> ImagineArt is a creative AI platform that lets anyone generate images, video, and music using frontier AI models on a single canvas. Founded in 2018, bootstrapped from Pakistan, now one of the world's top creative AI platforms.

## Company Overview

- **Founded:** 2018
- **Headquarters:** Islamabad, Pakistan (also SF office)
- **Stage:** Growth-stage, profitable, bootstrapped — no outside funding
- **Daily Active Users:** 800,000+
- **Total Downloads:** 150 million+
- **Annual Recurring Revenue:** $35M+
- **Team size:** Small (< 50 people)

## Founders

- **Ahmed Abubakr** — Co-founder & CEO. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmed-abubakar-9482127b/
- **Abdullah Rafique** — Co-founder & CTO. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdullahrafiq/
- **Zain ul Abedien** — Co-founder & CGO. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zain-vyro-ai/

## Product

ImagineArt bundles every frontier AI model — image generation, video synthesis, music creation, and editing — into one creative canvas. Users can generate without switching tools or tabs.

Website: https://www.imagine.art

## Careers

ImagineArt is actively hiring across engineering, design, and marketing.

- **Careers page:** https://imagine.art/careers
- **All open roles:** https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/imagineart
- **Contact:** talent@imagine.art

### Current hiring areas

- Engineering: ML, Full Stack, Frontend, MLOps, Agentic AI
- Product & Design: Product Designer, Graphic Designer
- Growth & Marketing: Creator Community Manager
- Operations: Sales Development Representative

### Hiring process (1–2 weeks total)

1. Apply — two minutes, no cover letter, show something you've made
2. Intro call — HR round to understand what you're looking for
3. Technical round — deep-dive with the technical lead
4. Task round — work through a real problem the way you actually work
5. Co-founder round — meet a founder, discuss vision and values
6. Offer — fast decisions

### Location

Most engineering roles are on-site in **Islamabad, Pakistan**. Select roles (e.g. Principal AI Engineer) are **fully remote** and open worldwide.

## Values

- Taste is a feature — craft and aesthetic judgment are core to what ships
- Creators come first — every decision starts with the maker using the product
- Ship at the speed of AI — prototype in days, launch in weeks
- Small teams, huge surface — real ownership over large problems
- Show, don't tell — working demos beat decks
- Own the outcome — not the task, the result

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where is ImagineArt based?**
Islamabad, Pakistan, with a San Francisco office. Remote roles exist.

**How long does hiring take?**
1–2 weeks from first conversation to offer.

**Is ImagineArt funded?**
No — bootstrapped from Day 1 and profitable.

**What makes ImagineArt different to work at?**
You ship to 800K+ daily users within weeks of joining. Small team, huge scope, no red tape.
